usageNotes: Use this endpoint to get a live snapshot of all resources across a PVE cluster registered as a PDM remote — VMs, LXC containers, nodes, storage pools, and SDN objects. The remote must be reachable from PDM and the caller must hold Resource.Audit on the remote; offline remotes will return an error rather than stale data. Omit the 'kind' filter to retrieve everything in one call, or pass a specific kind (vm, node, storage, sdn) to reduce payload size when only one resource type is needed.

examples.summary: List all running VMs on the 'pve-hetzner' remote

tips: The 'kind' value 'vm' returns both QEMU and LXC guests; discriminate by the 'type' property on each returned item ('qemu' vs 'lxc').
CPU values are fractional utilization ratios (e.g. 0.42 = 42%), not core counts — use 'maxcpu' for the core count.
Memory and disk fields are raw bytes; divide by 1073741824 for GiB display.
SDN resources (zones and fabrics) are only present when SDN is configured on the cluster; expect an empty list otherwise.
The 'node' field on guest resources reflects placement, not cluster membership — useful for identifying which physical host a VM is running on.
